newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Castillo suffers heart attack - reports.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Castillo suffers heart attack - reports.

text.p: A leading Mexican leftist politician was in critical condition early on Friday after suffering a heart attack on Thursday, media reports said.

Television networks said Heberto Castillo, a senator for the leftist Party of the Democratic Revolution (PRD), underwent emergency surgery late on Thursday at Mexico City's Angeles hospital and was in critical but stable condition.
Radio Red radio station said Castillo's doctors were hopeful the 67-year-old politician would survive.
Hospital officials were unavailable for comment.
Castillo is a well-known Mexican engineer and considered one of the ideological fathers of the PRD, which he helped found in the late 1980s.
A former protest leader and member of the now defunct Mexican Communist Party in the 1960s, Castillo was briefly jailed in the early 1970s but later set free.
